runtime_behavior: spawn slots are addressed by canonical generated spawn_id
host policy may explicitly enable or disable a materialized spawn slot
disabling a slot does not silently despawn an already living NPC
dead members of a disabled slot enter persisted respawn_suppressed state
due legacy respawns are suppressed deterministically before room admission
re-enabling a slot schedules suppressed members for immediate deterministic admission
spawn chance, group rolls, and native population maxima remain inactive

ownership.state: world-owned NPC metadata replicated across slot members

tests: disabled dead member loses due timer and records suppression
re-enable clears suppression and creates immediate due timer
safe_fallback: No probabilistic or native population behavior is inferred. Disabled slots suppress only future respawn admission.
